title: Scheduler redundancy and non-authority
purpose: Matching remains available across scheduler replacement while scheduler identity grants no canonical authority.
nonAuthority: scheduler cannot mutate request or offer commitments
scheduler cannot bypass canonical compatibility checks
scheduler cannot link or accept a market match into a canonical job
scheduler cannot redirect provider settlement account
scheduler cannot create a second accepted match for one request
exitCriteria: replacement scheduler can submit a fresh proposal after another scheduler proposal becomes stale
request owner can accept replacement proposal without granting scheduler authority
request owner can self-propose when external schedulers are unavailable
competing scheduler proposals preserve identical canonical request/offer commitments and quote for the same pair
losing scheduler cannot rewrite the accepted winner
retained Compute Market regressions and CMP-2.6 verifier pass on exact implementation SHA
